Muummeen Ministiraa Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii, gaaffii Ameerikaa kan biyyattii aangoo fi aadaa ishee miidhu jedhanii waan mormaniif tarkaanfichi fudhatame. Hayyoonni dinagdee akka ibsanitti, waldhabdeen daldalaa kun gatii meeshaalee gabaa irratti dabaluun fi baasii hojii daldalaa ol kaasuun dinagdee biyyoota lameenii irratti miidha geessisaa jira.

title: Gaza families search for children missing after years of war
english: Families in Gaza are desperately searching for children who went missing during the ongoing conflict. They are struggling to find information because official records have been destroyed and the region is heavily fragmented. Consequently, these families are calling on international organizations like the ICRC to help them locate their lost loved ones.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖሩ ቤተሰቦች በጦርነቱ ምክንያት የጠፉባቸውን ልጆች በከፍተኛ ጭንቀት እየፈለጉ ነው። መዝገቦች በመውደማቸው እና አካባቢው በመከፋፈሉ ምክንያት ስለ ቤተሰቦቻቸው መረጃ ለማግኘት ተቸግረዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ ቤተሰቦቹ የጠፉባቸውን ወገኖቻቸውን እንዲያገኙ እንዲረዳቸው እንደ ቀይ መስቀል ያሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማትን እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Maatiin Gaaza keessa jiraatan ijoollee waraana kanaan bade barbaaduuf yaalii cimaa gochaa jiru. Ragaaleen seenaa waan barbadaa’aniifii naannichi waan walitti hidhata hin qabneef, odeeffannoo argachuun rakkisaa ta'eera. Kanaafuu, maatiin kun lammiiwwan isaanii kan bade akka isaan bira ga'an dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa kan akka ICRC akka gargaaran gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran government signals fuel price hike on eve of new US sanctions
english: The Iranian government is preparing citizens for a potential fuel price hike as it struggles to manage a weakening economy amid new US sanctions and war. Officials argue that current heavy fuel subsidies are financially unsustainable given the country's shrinking GDP and the plummeting value of the rial. Because similar price increases have triggered widespread protests in the past, authorities are approaching the decision with extreme caution.
amharic: የኢራን መንግስት በአዲሱ የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ እና በጦርነት ምክንያት እየተዳከመ የመጣውን ኢኮኖሚ ለማስተካከል የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመጨመር እየተዘጋጀ ነው። መንግስት ከፍተኛ የነዳጅ ድጎማዎችን መሸከም አቅቶት የሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚ አቅም እያሽቆለቆለ መምጣቱን በመግለጽ ዋጋውን ማስተካከል አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ከዚህ ቀደም ተመሳሳይ የዋጋ ጭማሪዎች ህዝባዊ አመጽ ቀስቅሰው ስለነበር፣ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ውሳኔ በጥንቃቄ እያጤኑት ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan tarkaanfiiwwan diinagdee Ameerikaa fi waraana ishee irratti labsame hordofee diinagdeen biyyattii waan hir'ateef, gatii boba'aa dabaluuf qophaa'aa jira. Mootummaan gatii boba'aa gadi aanaa ta'e kana gargaaruu dadhabuun isaa fi gatiin maallaqa biyyattii (Riyal) gadi bu'uu isaa hordofee jijjiiramoota kana gochuun dirqama ta'uu ibseera. Duraan gatii boba'aa irratti daballiin taasifame mormii uummataa waan kaasiseef, mootummaan murtoo kana irratti of eeggannoo guddaadhaan socho'aa jira.

title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘has not become Venezuela’ despite war and sanctions
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian claims that his country has remained resilient despite facing intense economic, military, and security pressures. He rejected comparisons to Venezuela, asserting that Iran continues to stand firm. These remarks emphasize the government's stance on overcoming ongoing international sanctions and conflicts.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዚዳንት መስኡድ ፔዘሽኪያን ሀገራቸው በኢኮኖሚ፣ በወታደራዊ እና በፀጥታ ዘርፎች ከፍተኛ ጫና ቢደርስባትም በፅናት መቆሟን ገልጸዋል። ከቬኔዙዌላ ጋር የሚደረግን ንጽጽር ውድቅ ያደረጉት ፕሬዚዳንቱ፣ ኢራን በአለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች እና ግጭቶች ውስጥም ቢሆን አቋሟን እንደጠበቀች አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii dhiibbaa diinagdee, waraanaafi nageenyaa cimaa keessa jirtus jabaattee dhaabbachuu ishee dubbataniiru. Iraan akka Veenezuweelaa taatee akka hin jirre kan ibsan pireezidaantichi, biyyattii adabbiiwwanafi walitti bu'iinsa addunyaa hunda dandamachaa akka jirtu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: France links rise in drownings to heatwaves
english: France is reporting a significant 14% increase in drowning deaths this summer compared to last year, with over 300 fatalities recorded since mid-June. Government officials attribute this rise to extreme heatwaves that are driving people to swim in dangerous, unsupervised locations like canals or rivers. Authorities are now urging the public to be cautious, noting that the physical shock of entering cold water on a hot day can be fatal, especially for elderly individuals.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ባለፈው ሰኔ ወር አጋማሽ አንስቶ ከ300 በላይ የመስጠም አደጋዎች መመዝገባቸውን አስታውቃለች፤ ይህም ካለፈው ዓመት ጋር ሲነጻጸር የ14 በመቶ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። የመንግሥት ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የሞት ቁጥር መጨመር በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ምክንያት ሰዎች ወደ ወንዞችና ቦዮች በመግባታቸው እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ባለሙያዎች በሞቃታማ ቀናት በድንገት ወደ ቀዝቃዛ ውሃ መግባት ለጤና አደገኛ እንደሆነና በተለይም በአዛውንቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚያሳድር በማስጠንቀቅ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Faransaayi keessatti ji'a waxabajjii irraa eegalee namoonni 300 ol bishaanitti liqimfamanii du'uun isaanii gabaafameera; kunis waggaa darbee wajjin yoo madaalamu daballiin 14% ta'u agarsiisa. Mootummaan akka jedhetti, du'i kun kan hirdhate oowwaa cimaa hordofee namoonni karaa seeraan alaa fi bakka eegumsa hin qabneetti daakuuf yaaluu isaaniitiin. Qaamoleen dhimmi ilaalu, guyyaa oowwaa bishaan qabbanaawaa keessatti daakuun qaama irratti tasa miidhaa geessisuu akka danda'u fi keessattuu maanguddoota irratti balaa guddaa akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: PM Tarique Rahman’s trip stalled: What it means for Bangladesh-India ties
english: The planned diplomatic visit of Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to India has been delayed due to ongoing tensions regarding the presence of ousted leader Sheikh Hasina in India. While both nations have sought to improve relations since Rahman took office in February, a recent public statement from Hasina has caused significant friction and halted travel plans. Officials from both countries are currently in discussions to resolve these diplomatic obstacles and reset the environment for future cooperation.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ታሪክ ራህማን ወደ ህንድ ለማድረግ የነበራቸው የመጀመሪያ የይፋዊ ጉብኝት፣ በስደት ላይ የምትገኘው የቀድሞ መሪ ሼክ ሃሲና በህንድ መኖር ሳቢያ ተስተጓጉሏል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነታቸውን ለማሻሻል ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ በቅርቡ ሃሲና የሰጧቸው መግለጫዎች በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቱ ላይ ውጥረት በመፍጠራቸው ጉብኝቱ እንዲራዘም አድርገዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የሁለቱ ሀገራት ባለስልጣናት ይህንን አለመግባባት ለመፍታት እና ወደፊት የሚደረጉ የጋራ ስራዎችን ለማቀላጠፍ ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Baangilaadeshi Taariq Raahmaan gara Indiyaatti taasiisuuf karoorfatan, sababa hoogganantuu durii Sheikh Haasiinaan biyya sana keessa qubachuutiin boodatti harkifateera. Biyyoonni lameen mootummaan Raahmaan gara aangootti erga dhufee booda hariiroo isaanii fooyyessuuf yaalii godhaa jiranus, ibsi Haasiinaan dhiheenya kana kennite rakkoo uumuun adeemsa imalichaa dhaabsiiseera. Ammaaf, jilaaleen biyyoota lamaanii gidduutti uumame kana furuufi hariiroo gara fuulduraa irratti marii gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Nordic nations ‘have lost confidence in Infantino’, demand FIFA reforms
english: Six Nordic football associations have officially declared they no longer trust FIFA President Gianni Infantino and are calling for his resignation. They are demanding an independent investigation into his controversial plan to sell stakes in tournaments to private investors. Furthermore, the group is pushing for a major overhaul of FIFA’s leadership structure to ensure better transparency and accountability.
amharic: ስድስት የሰሜን አውሮፓ አገራት እግር ኳስ ማህበራት የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖን አመራር እንደማይደግፉና ከኃላፊነታቸው እንዲነሱ እንደሚጠይቁ በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ማህበራቱ የፊፋ ውድድሮችን ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ የታቀደውን አወዛጋቢ እቅድ እንዲመረምር ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ይፈልጋሉ። በተጨማሪም የፊፋን የአስተዳደር ስርዓት ግልጽ እና ተጠያቂነት ባለው መልኩ እንደገና እንዲዋቀር እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waldaaleen kubbaa miilaa biyyoota Noordikii jahan, hogganaan FIFA Jaanii Infaantiinoo akka amantaa isaanii dhabe ibsuun, akka inni aangoo gadhiisu gaafataniiru. Infaantiinoon sagantaalee FIFA kan akka Waancaa Addunyaa irratti qooda fayyadamummaa namoota dhuunfaaf gurguruuf karoorfatee ture irratti qorannoon walaba ta'e akka gaggeeffamu barbaadu. Kana malees, FIFA keessatti bulchiinsa ifa ta'ee fi itti gaafatamummaa qabu akka diriirsu jajjabeessuutti jiru.

title: The Suez Crisis stopped the British Empire. Will Hormuz defeat the US?
english: A recent podcast episode explores historical parallels between the 1956 Suez Crisis and current tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. It examines how Egypt's decision to take control of the Suez Canal challenged imperial powers and permanently altered the global economy. The program questions whether similar dynamics regarding oil shipping and control over vital waterways could lead to significant geopolitical conflicts for the United States today.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ የፖድካስት ፕሮግራም እ.ኤ.አ በ1956 የተከሰተውን የሱዌዝ ቀውስ እና በዛሬው ጊዜ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ያለውን ውጥረት ያነጻጽራል። ግብፅ የሱዌዝን ቦይ መቆጣጠሯ በወቅቱ የነበሩትን ዓለም አቀፍ ኃያላን እንዴት እንደተገዳደረ እና የዓለምን ኢኮኖሚ ለዘለቄታው እንደለወጠው ያትታል። ፕሮግራሙ በነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመሮች ቁጥጥር ዙሪያ የሚነሱ ተመሳሳይ አደጋዎች ዛሬም በአሜሪካ ላይ ተመሳሳይ ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥሩ እንደሚችሉ ይቃኛል።
oromo: Sagantaan podkaastii haaraa tokko, rakkoo bara 1956 biyya Masrii keessatti dhalateefi walitti bu'iinsa yeroo ammaa bakka Hormuzitti mul'atu wal bira qabee ilaala. Masriin gola Suweez too'achuun ishee mootummoota guddaa biyya alaa akkamitti akka qorumsaatti fudhatameefi diinagdee addunyaa akkamitti akka jijjiire xiinxala. Sagantaan kun, dhimmi too'annaa daandii bishaanii fi geejjiba boba'aa kun yeroo ammaa dhiibbaa akkamii Amerikaarratti fiduu akka danda'u gaaffii kaasa.

title: Chelsea preview: Five key talking points for 2026-27 Premier League season
english: Chelsea is preparing for the 2026-27 Premier League season following their most challenging period in three decades. The club has appointed Xabi Alonso as their new manager in an effort to bring stability after years of inconsistent results and frequent leadership changes. Supporters are now looking to see if Alonso’s tactical approach can help the team recover and if star player Cole Palmer will remain central to their success.
amharic: ቼልሲ በያዝነው የ2026-27 የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመን ባለፉት ሦስት አሥርት ዓመታት ውስጥ ካጋጠመው እጅግ አስቸጋሪ ጊዜ በኋላ ለማገገም እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ክለቡ ባለፉት ዓመታት የታየውን የውጤት መዋዠቅ እና የአመራር ለውጥ ለማስተካከል ዣቢ አሎንሶን በአዲሱ አሰልጣኝነት ሾሟል። የአሎንሶ የሜዳ ላይ ስልቶች ቡድኑን ወደ ቀድሞ ስኬቱ ሊመልሱት ይችሉ እንደሆነ እና ኮል ፓልመር በቡድኑ ውስጥ የሚኖረው ሚና ምን እንደሚመስል ብዙዎች ይጠባበቃሉ።
oromo: ቼልሲ እግር ኳስ ክለብ ባለፉት ሰላሳ ዓመታት ውስጥ ካጋጠመው የውጤት መውደቅ በኋላ ለ2026-27 የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመን ጠንካራ ዝግጅት እያደረገ ይገኛል። ክለቡ የቆየውን የቡድን መረጋጋት ማጣት ለመፍታት ዣቢ አሎንሶን በአዲሱ ዋና አሰልጣኝነት ቀጥሯል። አሰልጣኝ አሎንሶ በታክቲክ አጠቃቀማቸው የቡድኑን ችግር መቅረፍ ይችላሉ ወይ የሚለው እና የኮከብ ተጫዋቹ ኮል ፓልመር በቡድኑ ስኬት ላይ የሚኖረው ተጽዕኖ በደጋፊዎች ዘንድ በጉጉት እየተጠበቀ ነው።

title: Heavy Israeli air strike hits warehouse in central Gaza
english: A powerful Israeli airstrike targeted a storage facility located to the east of Az-Zawayda in central Gaza. Footage from the scene captured the moment of the explosion, which produced a massive cloud of smoke and scattered debris across the area. Authorities are currently assessing the impact of the attack.
amharic: ኃይለኛ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በአዝ-ዛዋይዳ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል በሚገኝ መጋዘን ላይ ተፈጽሟል። የተመዘገበው ምስል ጥቃቱ በተፈጸመበት ወቅት ትልቅ የጭስ ደመና እና የፍርስራሽ ክምር በአካባቢው ሲሰራጭ ያሳያል። ባለስልጣናት የጥቃቱን መጠን እና ጉዳት እየመረመሩ ነው።
oromo: Humni qilleensaa Israa'el giddu-galeessa Gaazaa keessatti bakka kuusaa meeshaa tokko irratti haleellaa cimaa raawwateera. Viidiyoon haleellaa kanaa akkuma dhuka'ee aaraan guutamee fi meeshaaleen diigamanii bittinneeffaman agarsiisa. Aangeyyoonni haleellaa kanaan miidhaan qaqqabe hammam akka ta'e qorachaa jiru.

title: Four-year-old Palestinian killed in Israeli attack in Gaza
english: A four-year-old Palestinian boy named Mohammad Abdel-Salam Taha was killed during an Israeli airstrike on a building in the Zawayda area of central Gaza. The child succumbed to injuries caused by shrapnel, while six other people were also wounded in the same attack. This incident occurred alongside another strike in the Nuseirat refugee camp, highlighting the ongoing violence and lack of a ceasefire in the region.
amharic: መሐመድ አብደል-ሰላም ታሃ የተባለ የአራት ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ህፃን በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በዛዋይዳ በተፈፀመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ህይወቱ አልፏል። ህፃኑ የደረሰበትን የቁስል ጉዳት ተከትሎ በሆስፒታል ህክምና ላይ እያለ መሞቱ የተገለፀ ሲሆን፣ በዚሁ ጥቃት ሌሎች ስድስት ሰዎችም ቆስለዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በኑሴራት የስደተኞች ካምፕ ከተፈፀመ ሌላ ጥቃት ጋር ተያይዞ የተከሰተ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለውን ቀጣይ ግጭትና የተኩስ አቁም አለመኖር ያሳያል።
oromo: Mucaan umriin isaa waggaa afur kan ta'e Muhammad Abdulsalaam Taahaa jedhamu, haleellaa qilleensaa Israa'el kutaa Giza giddugaleessaatti argamu Zawaayidaatti gaggeessiteen du'eera. Mucaan kun xiyya kanaan miidhamee hospitaala erga geessamee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera; haleellaa kanaan namoonni ja'a biroon madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame buufata baqattootaa Nuseeraat keessatti haleellaan biroo gaggeeffamaa jirutti aanuudhaan, naannichatti waraanni akka hin dhaabanne fi tasgabbiin akka hin jirre kan mul'isuudha.

title: Iran discovers over 7.5 trillion cubic feet of gas, oil minister says
english: Iran's Oil Minister, Mohsen Paknejad, recently announced the discovery of a new natural gas reserve. The field is located south of the country's Fars Province and contains over 7.5 trillion cubic feet of gas. This find marks a significant addition to Iran's existing energy resources.
amharic: የኢራን የነዳጅ ሚኒስትር ሞህሰን ፓክነጃድ በደቡባዊ ፋርስ ግዛት አዲስ የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ክምችት መገኘቱን ይፋ አድርገዋል። በዚሁ አካባቢ የተገኘው የጋዝ ክምችት ከ7.5 ትሪሊዮን ኩቢክ ጫማ በላይ እንደሚሆን ተገልጿል። ይህ ግኝት ለሀገሪቱ የኢነርጂ አቅም ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ministirri boba'aa Iraan Mohsan Paaknejaad, naannoo fardii kibbaatti argamu keessatti kuusaan gaasii uumamaa haaraan argamuu isaa ibsaniiru. Kuusaan kun gaasii tiriliyoona 7.5 ol kan qabatu yoo ta'u, kunis qabeenya humna ibsaa biyyattii guddina guddaa kan fiduudha.

title: Twenty-five patients evacuated from Gaza to Egypt
english: Twenty-five patients along with 32 of their family members have successfully left Gaza for Egypt. The medical evacuation was conducted through the Rafah border crossing. This operation was organized with the support and coordination of the World Health Organization.
amharic: ሃያ አምስት ታካሚዎች ከነቤተሰቦቻቸው 32 አባላት ጋር ከጋዛ ወደ ግብፅ መውጣታቸው ተገልጿል። ህሙማኑ የተዛወሩት በራፋህ ድንበር በኩል ነው። ይህ የህክምና የማስወጣት ስራ በአለም ጤና ድርጅት አስተባባሪነት የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Namoonni dhukkubsatan 25 fi miseensonni maatii isaanii 32 ta’an Gaazaa keessaa gara Masriitti darbuun isaanii ibsameera. Namoonni kunneen daangaa Raafaah fayyadamuun gara Masriitti kan imalan yoo ta’u, sochii kana kan qindeessus Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaati.

title: DR Congo and M23 rebels agree roadmap for peace talks
english: The government of the Democratic Republic of Congo and the M23 rebel group have committed to a new roadmap for peace negotiations following international mediation in Switzerland. Both sides have agreed to establish a formal system to monitor ceasefire violations and track their progress toward fulfilling previous obligations. While this marks a significant diplomatic step, major disagreements over political reforms, sanctions, and prisoner releases still persist.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ መንግስት እና የኤም 23 አማፂ ቡድን በስዊዘርላንድ በተደረገ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርድር አዲስ የሰላም የጊዜ ሰሌዳ ለመከተል ተስማምተዋል። ሁለቱም ወገኖች የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶችን ለመከታተል እና ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን ቃል ኪዳኖች አፈፃፀም ለመገምገም የሚያስችል ስርዓት ለመዘርጋት ተስማምተዋል። ይህ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት ትልቅ እርምጃ ቢሆንም፣ በፖለቲካዊ ማሻሻያዎች፣ በእገዳዎች እና በእስረኞች መፈታት ዙሪያ ያሉ ልዩነቶች አሁንም ተፈተው አልቀሩም።
oromo: Mootummaan Rippaablika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo fi gareen finxaaleyyii M23 marii nageenyaa irratti walii galtee haaraa irra ga'aniiru. Gareen lamaanuu walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa cabsuu hordofuu fi hojiirra oolmaa waadaa duraanii mirkaneessuuf sirna to'annoo diriirsuuf walii galaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qalbii gaarii kan agarsiisu ta'us, dhimmoota jijjiirama siyaasaa, adabbiiwwanii fi gadhiisifamuu hidhamtootaa irratti waliigalteen bal'aan ammas hin jiru.

title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
english: Southern Thailand experienced a wave of over 50 coordinated arson attacks on Saturday night, resulting in at least two injuries and significant property damage. These strikes targeted government buildings, businesses, and infrastructure across three provinces, leading officials to briefly enforce a curfew in the hardest-hit area. While no group has claimed responsibility, the region has been defined by a long-standing separatist insurgency seeking more autonomy for the Muslim-majority provinces.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ምሽት በደቡባዊ ታይላንድ ከ50 በላይ የተቀናጁ የእሳት ማጥቃት ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶችን፣ የንግድ ተቋማትን እና መሠረተ ልማቶችን ኢላማ ያደረጉ ሲሆን ቢያንስ ሁለት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እስካሁን የትኛውም ቡድን ጥቃቱን የወሰደ ባይኖርም፣ አካባቢው ለዓመታት በአመጽ የተዋጠ እና ለራስ ገዝ አስተዳደር የሚታገሉ የጎሳ ታጣቂዎች እንቅስቃሴ የሚታይበት ነው።
oromo: Halkan Sambataatti, kibba Thaayilaand keessatti weerara ibiddaa walta'e gurguddaan 50 ol ta'an raawwatamaniiru; kunis namoota muraasa miidhuun biiroolee mootummaa fi qabeenya garaagaraa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Weerara kana eenyutu akka raawwate kan beeksise hin jiru, garuu naannichi kun waggoota dheeraaf mirga ofiin of bulchuu gaafachaa jiran warra finciltootaa wajjin wal qabatee jeequmsi keessa ture. Mootummaan naannichatti yeroo gabaabaaf daangaa deemsa halkan erga labsee booda, haalli tasgabbaa'eera.

title: Dozens of attacks in southern Thailand wound three people
english: A series of 51 coordinated arson and bombing attacks took place across southern Thailand on Saturday night, causing significant damage to government buildings, vehicles, and infrastructure. At least three people were injured during the incidents, which primarily affected the Narathiwat, Yala, and Pattani provinces. While no group has claimed responsibility for the violence, the region has a long history of separatist conflict that has persisted for two decades.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ምሽት በደቡባዊ ታይላንድ በተቀናጁ 51 የእሳት ማጥፊያ እና የቦምብ ጥቃቶች የመንግስት ቢሮዎች፣ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና መሰረተ ልማቶች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በነዚህ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን አብዛኞቹ ክስተቶች ናራቲዋት፣ ያላ እና ፓታኒ በተባሉ ግዛቶች ላይ ያተኮሩ ነበሩ። ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን ሃላፊነቱን የወሰደ ቡድን ባይኖርም፣ አካባቢው ላለፉት ሃያ ዓመታት በለየለት የውስጥ ግጭት ውስጥ የሚገኝ ነው።
oromo: Halkan Sambataatti, kibba Thaayilaandi keessatti weerara gubii fi boombii walitti qindaa'een walqabatu 51 ta'een, gamoonni mootummaa, konkolaatonni fi bu'uuraaleen misoomaa miidhaa cimaa irra ga'eera. Miidhaa kanaan yoo xiqqaate namoonni sadii kan madaa'an yoo ta'u, weerarichi baay'inaan naannoolee Naaraatiwaat, Yaalaa fi Paattaanii keessatti raawwatame. Hanga ammaatti gareen tokkollee itti gaafatamummaa kan hin fudhatin yoo ta'u, naannichi waggoota digdama darban keessa walitti bu'iinsa keessoo cimaa keessa ture.

title: AI fraud costing victims millions of dollars
english: Criminals are increasingly using artificial intelligence to create deepfake videos and audio that impersonate public figures and officials to scam people. These sophisticated frauds are becoming simpler to produce, leading to massive financial losses for victims globally, including one case in Singapore involving nearly $4 million. Experts warn that as the technology improves, these scams are becoming significantly more difficult for the public to detect.
amharic: ወንጀለኞች የሰውን ምስል እና ድምፅ በመምሰል ሰዎችን ለማጭበርበር አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን ወይም ዲፕፌክ ቴክኖሎጂን እየተጠቀሙ ነው። እነዚህ ማታለያዎች በቀላሉ ሊፈጠሩ የሚችሉ በመሆናቸው በሲንጋፖር አንድ ግለሰብ 4 ሚሊዮን ዶላር እንዲያጣ ማድረጋቸውን ጨምሮ በዓለም ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ እያስከተሉ ነው። የቴክኖሎጂው እድገት እነዚህን የማጭበርበር ተግባራት መለየት አስቸጋሪ እያደረገው መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Gochiwwan yakkaa gargaarsa teknolojiin 'artifishal intelejensii' fayyadamuun namoota beekamoo fi hoggantoota fakkaachuun maallaqa namoota irraa saamuun babal'achaa jira. Teknolojiin kun salphaatti kan hojjetamu waan ta'eef, miidhaan inni geessisu sadarkaa addunyaatti guddaa dha; fakkeenyaaf, namni tokko Siingapoori keessatti qofa miiliyoona 4 dolaararraa akka gowwoomfamu ta'eera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, teknolojiin kun fooyya'aa waan dhufeef, soba kana adda baasuun namootaaf baay'ee ulfaataa ta'aa jira.

title: Zelenskyy says wartime elections could ‘destroy’ Ukraine
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has dismissed calls to hold national elections during the ongoing conflict with Russia, warning that such a move would cause dangerous division within the country. While former Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov argued that the war should not prevent democratic processes, Zelenskyy insists that holding a vote now would be a catastrophic risk to national stability. Experts also note that hosting an election during active combat would be logistically impossible and unsafe for the population.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ከሩሲያ ጋር በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ወቅት ምርጫ ማካሄድ አገሪቱን ለከፋ ክፍፍል እና አደጋ እንደሚዳርግ ገለጹ። የቀድሞው የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ሚካሂሎ ፌዶሮቭ ጦርነቱ ዲሞክራሲን ማቆም የለበትም የሚል ሀሳብ ቢያቀርቡም፣ ዘሌንስኪ ግን በዚህ ወቅት የሚደረግ ምርጫ ለአገር ህልውና አስጊ ነው ብለዋል። ባለሙያዎች በበኩላቸው በጦርነት መካከል ምርጫ ማካሄድ ከደህንነት እና ከሎጂስቲክስ አንጻር የማይቻል መሆኑን ይስማማሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski waraana biyyattii keessa jiru kana gidduutti filannoo gaggeessuun biyyattii gargar hiruu fi balaaf saaxiluu akka danda'u ibsaniiru. Ministirri ittisaa duraanii Mihayilo Fiedorov filannoon gaggeeffamuu qaba jedhanii falmanis, Zeelenski garuu yeroo ammaatti filannoo gaggeessuun nageenya biyyattiitiif yaaddoo guddaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Hayyoonni gamasaaniin, waraana cimaa keessatti filannoo gaggeessuun haala qabatamaa jiruun tasumaa kan hin danda'amne fi lammiilee balaaf kan saaxilu ta'uu ibsu.

title: DR Congo miners risk Ebola to make a living
english: Miners in the Democratic Republic of Congo are continuing their work despite the threat of Ebola outbreaks. Their frequent movement between areas makes it very hard for health authorities to control the spread of the virus. The workers explain that they must keep mining because they have no other way to support themselves and their families.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የሚገኙ ማዕድን አውጪዎች የኢቦላ በሽታ ስጋት ቢኖርባቸውም ስራቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ማዕድን አውጪዎቹ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በየጊዜው መዘዋወራቸው የጤና ባለሙያዎች በሽታውን ለመቆጣጠር የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት አዳጋች አድርጎታል። ሰራተኞቹ እንደገለጹት ቤተሰባቸውን ለማስተዳደር ከዚህ ውጭ ሌላ አማራጭ የላቸውም።
oromo: Hojjettoonni qodduu qotaa biyya Koongoo keessa jiran, vaayirasii Eebolaa sodaachisu keessattuu hojii isaanii itti fufanii jiru. Hojjettoonni kunneen bakka tokkoo gara bakka biraatti deddeebi'anii hojjechuun isaanii, ogeeyyonni fayyaa dhukkubicha to'achuuf carraaqqii godhan akka hin milkoofne taasisee jira. Hojjettoonni kunniin akka jedhanitti, maatii isaanii jiraachisuuf hojii kana malee filannoo biraa akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: Real Madrid’s Mourinho condemns bullying of Vinicius after La Liga win
english: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho has publicly spoken out against the mistreatment and bullying of star forward Vinicius Junior by both rival supporters and opposing players. While Mourinho acknowledged that the young player is not entirely faultless, he stressed that the hostile behavior directed at him is unacceptable. This commentary follows a successful La Liga opening match where Vinicius played a crucial role in securing a victory for his team.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አሰልጣኝ ሆዜ ሞሪንሆ በቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር ላይ በተቃዋሚ ደጋፊዎችና ተጫዋቾች የሚደርሰውን እንግልትና ትንኮሳ አውግዘዋል። አሰልጣኙ ተጫዋቹ ፍጹም እንዳልሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ በወጣቱ ኮከብ ላይ የሚፈጸመው ኢ-ሰብአዊ ድርጊት ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው አስረድተዋል። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው ቪኒሲየስ ለቡድኑ ድል ወሳኝ ሚና በተጫወተበት የላሊጋ መክፈቻ ጨዋታ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee Real Madrid Jose Mourinho, miidhaa fi balaleeffannaa Vinicius Junior irratti mormitootaa fi taphatoota morkattootaan raawwatamu cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru. Mourinho taphatichi gonkumaa dogoggora kan hin qabne akka hin taane ibsanillee, gochi hamaa irratti raawwatamu fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu hubachiisaniiru. Yaada kana kan kennan erga gareen isaanii tapha jalqabaa La Liga irratti injifannoo argatee booda.

title: Child shot dead by Israeli forces during raid in Nablus
english: A 14-year-old Palestinian boy was killed after being shot in the chest by Israeli military personnel. The incident occurred during an operational raid conducted by Israeli forces in the Askar refugee camp, located near Nablus. Medical officials confirmed the fatality following the shooting.
amharic: በናብለስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው አስካር የስደተኞች ካምፕ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ባደረጉት ወረራ የ14 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ታዳጊ በደረሰበት ጥይት ህይወቱ አልፏል። ታዳጊው በጥይት የተመታው በደረቱ መሆኑን የህክምና ምንጮች አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተፈጠረው ወታደሮቹ በካምፑ ውስጥ ኦፕሬሽን በማካሄድ ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Naablusitti buufata baqattootaa Askaar jedhamu keessatti waraanni Israa'el duula gaggeessaniin dargaggeessi umriin isaa waggaa 14 ta'e tokko rasaasaan rukutamee du'eera. Maddi fayyaa akka ibsetti, dargaggeessi kun qoma isaa irratti rukutamee battalumatti lubbuun isaa darbe. Kun kan ta'e yeroo waraanni Israa'el buufata sana keessatti tarkaanfii fudhachaa turanidha.

title: Israeli attack in central Gaza kills two, wounds seven
english: An Israeli military strike in the central Gaza Strip has resulted in the deaths of two Palestinians. Additionally, seven other individuals sustained injuries during the attack, which targeted the Nuseirat refugee camp and the town of az-Zawayda. These figures were confirmed by medical personnel at the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ ሰባት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በኑሲራት የስደተኞች ካምፕ እና በአዛዋይዳ ከተማ ላይ ነው። የሟቾች እና የተጎጂዎች መረጃ በአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የተረጋገጠ ነው።
oromo: Iccitii Israa'el giddu-galeessa Gaazaatti gaggeessiteen namoonni Falasxiin lama ajjeefamanii, torban immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame buufata baqattootaa Nuseiraat fi magaala az-Zawaydaa irratti dha. Odeeffannoon kun hospitaala Al-Aqsa Martyrs irraa kan mirkanaa'e dha.

title: Iranian cyber attack shuts down UK power plant for four days, report says
english: A report indicates that Iranian hackers successfully disabled a small-scale British power facility for four days, marking a notable escalation in cyber tensions. While the UK government confirmed the incident, they emphasized that it posed no threat to the national power grid and caused no widespread outages. This cyber attack is believed to be a retaliatory measure following the UK's decision to allow the US to launch military operations against Iranian targets from British bases.
amharic: የኢራን ጠላፊዎች በብሪታንያ የሚገኝ አነስተኛ የኃይል ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ለአራት ቀናት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቆም ማድረጋቸውን ዘገባዎች ጠቁመዋል። የብሪታንያ መንግሥት ጥቃቱ መፈጸሙን ያረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ በሀገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት ላይ ምንም ዓይነት ስጋት እንዳልፈጠረ ገልጿል። ይህ የሳይበር ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ብሪታንያ አሜሪካ ከግዛቷ ተነስታ በኢራን ኢላማዎች ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንድትወስድ ከፈቀደች በኋላ እንደ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ የታየ ነው።

title: US Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed rebuts criticism from JD Vance
english: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed has publicly rejected criticism directed at him by Vice President JD Vance. El-Sayed stated that his personal background and religious identity have no connection to the political difficulties currently facing the Trump administration. He urged the Vice President to refrain from using him as a target in ongoing political debates.
amharic: የሚቺጋን የሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በእሳቸው ላይ የሰነዘሩትን ትችት ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የራሳቸው ማንነት እና ሃይማኖት ከትራምፕ አስተዳደር ችግሮች ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌላቸው ገልጸዋል። በመሆኑም ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንቱ በፖለቲካዊ ክርክራቸው ውስጥ ስማቸውን ከመጥቀስ እንዲቆጠቡ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Kaadhimamaan seeneeti Michigan Abdul El-Sayed, qeeqa itti aanaa pirezidaantii JD Vance isa irratti dhiyeessan haaleera. Abdul, eenyummaan isaa fi amantiin isaa rakkoolee bulchiinsa Trump mudachaa jiru wajjin walitti hidhata akka hin qabne ibseera. Innis itti aanaa pirezidaantichaa falmii siyaasaa isaanii keessatti maqaa isaa kaasuu akka dhiisan gaafateera.

title: Can Iran retaliate against countries that join US ‘economic war’?
english: Iran has issued a stern warning that any nation supporting US economic sanctions against it will be treated as a hostile entity. Officials threatened severe retaliation, including the potential blockage of all oil exports from the Gulf region. This escalation occurs as diplomatic peace efforts stall and the US prepares to launch further restrictive measures against the Iranian economy.
amharic: ኢራን በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ውስጥ የሚሳተፍ ማንኛውም ሀገር እንደ ጠላት እንደሚቆጠር ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥታለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ማዕቀቡን የሚደግፉ ሀገራት ላይ ከፍተኛ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱና ከባህረ ሰላጤው የሚወጣውን የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ሊያቆሙ እንደሚችሉ አስፈራርተዋል። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች መክሸፋቸውን ተከትሎ አሜሪካ በአገሪቱ ላይ አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦችን ለመጣል በዝግጅት ላይ ባለችበት ወቅት ነው።

Hojjettoonni mootummaa Iiraan, biyyoonni maallaqaafi diinagdeen ishee irratti duulan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu fi balbala galaana Goolf irraa boba'aan akka hin baane gochuu akka danda'an doorsisaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan uumame, carraaqqiin nagaa utuu hin milkaa'in fi Ameerikaan tarkaanfii diinagdee dabalataa Iiraan irratti fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jirtu keessatti.

title: Sydney Marathon organisers not running away from ‘unfortunate’ medal error
english: The organizers of the Sydney Marathon have acknowledged a mistake on the event's finisher medals, which incorrectly feature Germany's Allianz Arena instead of Sydney's Allianz Stadium. Despite the error, the organizers decided to keep the medals as they are, humorously describing them as unique mementos for the 40,000 expected participants. They emphasized that the accomplishment of the runners is far more important than the design flaw on the hardware.
amharic: የሲድኒ ማራቶን አዘጋጆች በውድድሩ ማጠናቀቂያ ሜዳሊያዎች ላይ የጀርመኑን አሊያንዝ አሬና በስህተት በማሳየታቸው ስህተቱን አምነዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ስህተት ቢኖርም አዘጋጆቹ ሜዳሊያዎቹን ሳይቀይሩ ለመጠቀም ወስነዋል፤ ይህም በ40,000 ተሳታፊዎች ዘንድ በፈገግታ የታጀበ ልዩ ትውስታ እንዲሆን አድርገውታል። አዘጋጆቹም የአትሌቶቹ ድል ከሜዳሊያው ዲዛይን ስህተት በላይ ትልቅ ዋጋ ያለው መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Qindeessitoonni Kaayyoo Maaraatoonii Siidinii baddeessa baddeessa meetaliyaa xumuraa irratti argame beekamtii kennaniiru, sababni isaas meetaliyaa sana irratti buufata istaadiyeemii Siidinii jijjiruu istaadiyeemii Jarmanii Allianz Arena bakka buusuu isaati. Dogoggora kanaafis, qindeessitoonni meetaliyaa sana akkasumatti ittifufsiisuuf murteessaniiru, kunis namoota 40,000 fiigicha kanatti hirmaatan hundaaf yaadannoo addaa akka ta'u ibsaniiru. Qindeessitoonni kunniin, injifannoon fiigichaa dogoggora suuraa sanaa caalaa akka ta'e jala muranii ibsaniiru.

title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a National Dialogue, but many in the Somali Region worry the process could be used to weaken the current federal system and constitutional protections for regional self-determination. While Somalis feel the existing government framework has failed to address their economic and political marginalization, they view key constitutional clauses as essential safeguards against central overreach. There is significant concern that the dialogue might prioritize moving toward a more centralized government, which threatens the regional autonomy they heavily rely upon.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ የምክክር መድረክ የጀመረች ቢሆንም፣ በሶማሌ ክልል የሚገኙ ብዙዎች ይህ ሂደት የፌዴራል ስርዓቱን እና የክልል ራስን በራስ የማስተዳደር መብትን ለማዳከም ሊውል ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የሶማሌ ህዝብ የአሁኑ የፖለቲካ ስርዓት የኢኮኖሚ እና የፖለቲካ ተጠቃሚነታቸውን እንዳላረጋገጠ ቢሰማም፣ በህገ መንግስቱ ውስጥ ያሉ መብቶች ከማዕከላዊ መንግስት የበላይነት ለመጠበቂያ ዋና መሰረት አድርገው ይወስዷቸዋል። የምክክር መድረኩ ሀገሪቱን ወደ ማዕከላዊ አስተዳደር ለመቀየር የሚያገለግል ከሆነ የክልሉን ራስ ገዝነት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ከፍተኛ ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan marii biyyoolessaa jalqabdus, namoonni naannoo Somaalee hedduun adeemsi kun sirna federaalaa fi mirga ofiin of bulchuu naannolee dadhabsiisuuf itti fayyadama jedhanii yaadu. Uummatni Somaalee sirni amma jiru fayyadamummaa siyaasaa fi dinagdee isaanii mirkaneessuu dhabu illee, seera buuuraa keessatti mirgoonni jiran garuu dhiibbaa giddu-galeessaa ofirraa ittisuuf gargaarsa ijoo akka ta'anitti ilaalu. Mariin kun biyya gara sirna giddu-galeessummaa (centralized) tti deebisuuf kan yaadame yoo ta'e, ofiin of bulchuu naannoo sanaa miidhuu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu.

title: Explosion injures 13 in Taiwan
english: A major explosion occurred at a waste disposal facility in Tainan, Taiwan, while emergency crews were responding to a fire. The blast resulted in injuries to 13 people, including both local residents and firefighters who were on the scene. Authorities are currently managing the aftermath of the incident.
amharic: ታይዋን ውስጥ በምትገኘው ታይናን ከተማ በሚገኝ የቆሻሻ ማጠራቀሚያ ቦታ ላይ በተከሰተ ድንገተኛ ፍንዳታ 13 ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፍንዳታው የተከሰተው የእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት በሚሰሩበት ወቅት ነው። ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከል የእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞች እና የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደሚገኙበት ታውቋል።
oromo: Taiwan, magaalaa Taayinaaniitti iddoo qulqulleeffannaa kosii irratti balaa dhohinsaa cimaa tokkoon namoonni 13 miidhamaniiru. Dhohinsi kun kan mudate yeroo gareen dhaamsibitoota ibiddaa ibidda sana dhaamsuuf tattaaffii gochaa turanitti dha. Namoota miidhaman keessas dhaamsibitoota ibiddaa fi jiraattotni naannichaa akka jiran himameera.

title: Israel’s war on Gaza forces Palestinians to rely on ‘Stone Age’ toilets
english: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza are facing a severe sanitation crisis due to the ongoing conflict and destruction of infrastructure. Many families are forced to use primitive, makeshift toilets because modern bathroom supplies have become prohibitively expensive or unavailable under the blockade. This lack of basic facilities is deeply affecting the privacy, health, and dignity of displaced residents, particularly those who are sick or have children.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ተፈናቃይ ፍልስጤማውያን በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በከፍተኛ የንፅህና አጠባበቅ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። መሰረታዊ የሆኑ የመጸዳጃ ቤት እቃዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመወደዳቸው እና በመጥፋታቸው፣ ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ጉድጓድ በመቆፈር የሚጠቀሙባቸውን ጊዜያዊ መጸዳጃ ቤቶች ለመጠቀም ተገደዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በተለይም ለታማሚዎችና ለህጻናት ከፍተኛ የጤናና የክብር ችግር እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Oromoonni magaalaa Gaazaatti buqqa'an waraanaafi manca'iinsa bu'uuraalee misoomaa irraa kan ka'e rakkoo qulqullinaa cimaa keessa jiru. Meeshaaleen manaa fincaanii hammayyaa gatii isaanii ol ka'uufi gabaa keessatti dhabamuun, maatiiwwan hedduu boolla qotanii itti fayyadamuun dirqama isaanitti ta'eera. Haalli kun keessattuu namoota dhukkubsatootaafi daa'immanirratti miidhaafi qaanii guddaa geessisaa jira.

title: Mourinho decries alleged bullying of Vinicius in Real’s win at Espanyol
english: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho has condemned the persistent bullying of forward Vinicius Junior by opposing players and fans. Following a recent victory over Espanyol, Mourinho stated that the rough treatment of the Brazilian winger has become a repetitive and unacceptable pattern. He emphasized that while Vinicius must manage his emotions, the club and society need to protect the player from ongoing harassment.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አሰልጠና ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ተጫዋቻቸው ቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር በተጋጣሚ ቡድኖች እና በደጋፊዎች እየደረሰበት ያለውን እንግልት አውግዘዋል። ከኤስፓንዮል ጋር በተደረገው ጨዋታ በኋላ በሰጡት አስተያየት፣ በቪኒሲየስ ላይ የሚፈጸመው አካላዊ ጥቃት ተደጋጋሚ እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው ድርጊት መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ሞሪንሆ አክለውም ተጫዋቹ ስሜቱን መቆጣጠር ቢኖርበትም፣ ማህበረሰቡ እና ክለቡ ከዚህ አላስፈላጊ በደል ሊከላከሉት እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee Real Madrid Jose Mourinho, taphataan isaanii Vinicius Junior mormitoota fi daawwattoota biraa miidhaa fi dararaa irra gahaa jiru cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Tapha Espanyol waliin ta'een booda, miidhaan dargaggeessa kana irra gahaa jiru barsiifata irra deddeebi'amee raawwatamu fi fudhatama hin qabne ta'uu ibsaniiru. Mourinho, taphataan kun miira isaa to'achuu qabaatus, hawaasni fi gareen isaa dararaa kana irraa isa ittisuu qaban jedhaniiru.

title: Syria foreign minister says door open for diplomacy with Israel
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani has expressed readiness to engage in diplomatic talks with Israel to secure an Israeli withdrawal from Syrian land. While the Syrian government remains skeptical and currently lacks trust in Israel, it hopes to stop ongoing military strikes through a security agreement. Talks were previously suspended due to regional conflicts, but officials are optimistic that negotiations regarding the occupied territories will restart in the near future.
amharic: የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አሳድ አል-ሻይባኒ እስራኤል ከያዘችው የሶሪያ ግዛት እንድትወጣ ለማድረግ ከእስራኤል ጋር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመነጋገር ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። የሶሪያ መንግስት በእስራኤል ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥርጣሬ ቢኖረውም፣ በስምምነት አማካኝነት በሀገሪቱ ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ለማስቆም ይፈልጋል። ቀደም ሲል በክልሉ በተከሰቱ ግጭቶች የተቋረጠው ይህ የሰላም ውይይት በቅርቡ እንደገና እንደሚጀመር ተስፋ ተጥሏል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Suuriyaa Asaad al-Shaibanii, Israa'el lafa Suuriyaa keessaa akka baatuuf marii diippiloomaasii taasisuuf fedhii akka qaban ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Suuriyaa Israa'el irratti amantii kan hin qabne ta'us, waliigaltee nageenyaa uumuudhaan haleellaa waraanaa dhaabsisuuf yaala. Mariin kun kanaan dura sababa walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti uumameen kan addaan cite ta'us, gara fuulduraatti deebi'ee akka jalqabuuf abdiin jira.

title: Far-right provocateur Jake Lang arrested after Minneapolis riot
english: Far-right influencer Jake Lang was taken into custody following a violent confrontation at his rally near Minneapolis City Hall. Authorities reported that Lang and his associates used chemical sprays and drove vehicles toward counter-protesters during the incident. He is currently being held on charges related to rioting.
amharic: የጽንፈኛው ቀኝ አቀንቃኝ ጄክ ላንግ በሚኒያፖሊስ ከተማ አዳራሽ አቅራቢያ በተካሄደ ሰልፍ ላይ ሁከት በመፍጠሩ በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ባለሥልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ ላንግ እና ደጋፊዎቹ በፀረ-ሰልፈኞች ላይ ኬሚካሎችን በመርጨት እና መኪናዎችን ወደ እነሱ በማሽከርከር ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት በሁከት ወንጀል ተጠርጥሮ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል።
oromo: Garee mirga-qabiyyee garmalee kan ta'e Jake Lang, magaala Minneapolisitti walgahii inni qopheesse irratti hiriira jeequmsaa uumuun isaa erga beekamee booda poolisiin to'atameera. Abbootiin taayitaa akka ibsanitti, Lang fi deggertoonni isaa mormitoota irratti xurii keemikaalaa fayyadamuudhaan fi konkolaataadhaan itti yaa'uudhaan walitti bu'iinsa uumaniiru. Yeroo ammaa kana yakka jeequmsaa raawwachuun shakkamee to'annoo jala jira.

title: South Africa’s former boxing champion Tete shot dead outside home
english: Former South African boxing champion Zolani Tete was tragically killed by gunfire near his residence in the Eastern Cape province. Authorities have initiated a formal murder investigation to determine the circumstances behind the attack. No suspects have been apprehended yet as the police work to uncover the motive for this crime.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ የቀድሞ የቦክስ ሻምፒዮን ዞላኒ ቴቴ በምስራቅ ኬፕ ግዛት በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤታቸው አቅራቢያ በጥይት ተመትተው ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የሀገሪቱ የጸጥታ አካላት በግድያው ዙሪያ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ በወንጀሉ ተጠያቂ የሆኑ ወገኖች በቁጥጥር ስር አልዋሉም።
oromo: Gootee boorsii durii kan Afrikaa Kibbaa Zolani Teetee jedhaman mana isaanii kan naannoo Isteern Keep jedhamuutti dhukaasa irratti banameen lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Poolisiin naannichaa dhimmicha qorachuuf hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti namni shakkamee qabame hin jiru.

title: In Kfarchouba, life is 'a big prison' under Israeli occupation of south Lebanon
english: Residents of the Lebanese village of Kfarchouba are living under strict military control, isolation, and constant surveillance by Israeli forces. Although they have avoided displacement, they face severe restrictions on their movement and are barred from accessing their own agricultural lands. The village leaders are under pressure to prevent any armed groups from entering the area, as failure to comply could result in the village being destroyed. This atmosphere of fear and insecurity has left the local population feeling as though they are trapped in a large prison.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የምትገኘው የክፋርቹባ መንደር ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር ስር፣ ጥብቅ ክልከላ እና የማያቋርጥ ክትትል ስር ይገኛሉ። ከመፈናቀል ቢተርፉም፣ የነዋሪዎቹ እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ የተገደበ ከመሆኑም በላይ የራሳቸውን የእርሻ መሬት እንዳይጠቀሙ ተከልክለዋል። የመንደሩ መሪዎች የታጠቁ ኃይሎች ወደ አካባቢው እንዳይገቡ እንዲያረጋግጡ የተገደዱ ሲሆን፣ ይህን ካላደረጉ መንደራቸው የመውደም ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል። በዚህ የፍርሃት እና የጥበቃ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ያሉ ነዋሪዎች፣ ሕይወታቸው ልክ እንደ ትልቅ እስር ቤት እንደሆነ ይሰማቸዋል።
oromo: jiraattoonni baadiyaa Kfarchouba kan kibba Libanon jiru, to'annoo waraana Israa'elii fi daangaa cimaa jala jiraatu. Oggaa irraa buqqa'uu oolaniyyuu, sochiin isaanii daangeffamee fi lafa qonnaa isaanii fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye dhorkamaniiru. Hogganoonni baadiyyaa sun gareen hidhattootaa naannicha akka hin seenne akka to'atan dirqisiifamaniiru; yoo kana gochuu baatan baadiyyaan isaanii akka diigamu sodaachifamaniiru. Haala sodaa fi mirga dhabuu kana keessa kan jiran jiraattoonni, jireenyi isaanii akka mana hidhaa guddaa tokkootti nutti dhaga'ama jedhu.

title: How the deadliest Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak can be stopped
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is currently facing its second-largest Ebola outbreak, which has been exacerbated by ongoing regional conflict and displacement. Experts emphasize that the most effective way to contain the virus is by empowering local communities to lead the response and providing frontline health workers with the safety, resources, and support they require. Combining this grassroots involvement with swift international action is essential to curbing the spread of the disease.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ኮንጎ በአሁኑ ወቅት በታሪክ ሁለተኛው ትልቅ የሆነውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እየተጋፈጠች ትገኛለች፤ ይህም በክልሉ ባለው ግጭትና የህዝብ መፈናቀል ምክንያት ተባብሷል። ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር የአካባቢውን ማህበረሰቦች በማሳተፍ እና የጤና ሰራተኞችን አስፈላጊ በሆነ የጥበቃ ቁሳቁስና ድጋፍ ማገዝ ወሳኝ መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ያስረዳሉ። ይህንን የህብረተሰብ ተሳትፎ ከአለም አቀፍ ፈጣን ምላሽ ጋር በማቀናጀት የበሽታውን መስፋፋት መግታት ይቻላል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola lammata isa guddaa ta'e kan mudate yoo ta'u, rakkoon nageenyaa fi buqqaatiin namootaa dhibicha daran hammaachiiseera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, dhibicha to'achuuf gargaaruu kan danda'u hawaasa naannichaa of keessatti hammachuu fi hojjettoota fayyaa duratti argamaniif meeshaalee eegumsaa fi deeggarsa barbaachisu guutuudha. Hawaasaa fi qaamolee idil-addunyaa walta'anii hojjechuun dhibee kana dhaabsisuun ni danda'ama.

title: Israeli air strike near Gaza refugee camp kills one person and injures two
english: An Israeli airstrike conducted near the Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza has resulted in one death and two injuries. This incident follows a similar drone attack in Deir el-Balah that occurred just one day earlier. These ongoing hostilities continue to increase the high casualty count among Palestinians as the conflict persists.
amharic: በጋዛ ማዕከላዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው የማጋዚ የስደተኞች ካምፕ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሁለት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ አንድ ቀን በፊት በዴይር ኤል-ባላህ ከተማ በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ የሰው ህይወት የጠፋበት የድሮን ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። ግጭቱ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ የሚደርሰው የሟቾች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo buufata baqattoota Magaazii kan Gaazaatti haleellaa xiyyaaraan geggeesseen namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni lama immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa tokko dura magaalaa Deeyr el-Baalahitti haleellaa doroonii raawwatamee boodadha. Walitti bu'iinsi kun itti fufuun isaa lakkoofsa namoota du'anii fi madaa'anirratti dabala guddaa geessisaa jira.

title: Israeli military raids continue across the West Bank
english: Israeli military forces and settlers have intensified their operations across the West Bank, leading to multiple arrests, injuries, and the destruction of Palestinian property. Throughout the weekend, soldiers raided several towns, blocked village entrances, and harassed residents, while settlers assaulted locals and uprooted crops. A critical humanitarian situation has emerged in Qusra, where a two-week siege has left families without access to essential supplies like water.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች እና ሰፈራተኞች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ዘመቻቸውን በማጠናከር በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል፣ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል እንዲሁም የንብረት ውድመት አስከትለዋል። ቅዳሜና እሁድ በተካሄዱ ወረራዎች ወታደሮች የተለያዩ ከተሞችን በመዝጋት ነዋሪዎችን ሲያጉላሉ፣ ሰፈራተኞች ደግሞ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር የሰብል እርሻዎችን አውድመዋል። በተለይም በቁስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች ለሁለት ሳምንታት በዘለቀው ከበባ ምክንያት የውሃ እና መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶች እጥረት ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni biyya bulchan (settlers) naannoo Zoonii Lixaa keessatti duula isaanii cimsuun, namoota hedduu hidhuu fi qabeenya Paalestaayinii irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Wiixata fi Dilbata darbe, waraanni magaalota garaagaraa ugguruun jiraattota dararaa turan; qonnaan bultoonni ammoo ummata irratti miidhaa geessisuu fi midhaan lafa keessaa buqqisuu raawwataniiru. Keessattuu baadiyaa Qusraa keessatti, jiraattonni torban lamaaf marfamuun isaanii bishaan dabalatee meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an akka dhaban godheera.

title: Israeli air strike in central Gaza kills one, wounds two
english: A recent Israeli airstrike on Salah al-Din Street in central Gaza resulted in one death and two injuries. This incident adds to the ongoing conflict, which has caused hundreds of thousands of casualties since October 2023. Medical reports confirm that the death toll in the region continues to climb as military operations persist.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ በሚገኘው ሳላህ አል-ዲን ጎዳና ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሁለት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ ነው። በዘገባው መሰረት፣ በአካባቢው የሟቾች እና የተጎጂዎች ቁጥር በየጊዜው እየጨመረ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el giddu-galeessa Gaazaa, daandii Salah al-Diin irratti raawwateen namni tokko yoo du'u, lama immoo miidhamaniiru. Hojiin waraanaa kun itti fufiinsa waraana Adoolessa 2023 irraa jalqabee turee dha. Gabaasni yaala fayyaa akka ibsutti, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii fi miidhamanii guyyuu dabalaa jira.

title: Pakistan army chief set to visit Tehran on Monday
english: Pakistan's army chief, General Asim Munir, is traveling to Tehran on Monday to meet with Iranian officials. The visit aims to improve regional security and stability following recent discussions about reviving stalled ceasefire efforts. As a key mediator, Pakistan is working closely with Iran to address ongoing challenges in the Middle East.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የጦር ኃይሎች አዛዥ ጄኔራል አሲም ሙኒር ከኢራን ባለስልጣናት ጋር ለመወያየት ሰኞ እለት ወደ ቴህራን ያመራሉ። ጉብኝቱ በክልሉ የሰላምና የደህንነት ሁኔታን ለማጠናከር እንዲሁም የቆሙ የተኩስ አቁም ንግግሮችን እንደገና ለማደስ ያለመ ነው። ፓኪስታን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ዘላቂ ሰላም እንዲሰፍን እንደ አደራዳሪነት ሚናዋን እየተወጣች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Paakistaan Jeneraal Asim Muniir, mootummaa Iraan waliin mari'achuuf guyyaa Wiixataa gara Teheran imaluuf qophaa'aniiru. Imalli kun nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf fi mariilee dhaabbataa turee deebisanii jalqabuuf gargaara. Paakistaan gama isheenis biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaa keessatti nageenya buusuuf akka giddu-galeessatti tattaaffii gochaa jirti.

title: The hotel booking mix-up that could free mushroom murderer
english: Erin Patterson, convicted for a fatal mushroom poisoning incident, is seeking a retrial due to a significant procedural error during her case. Because a local table tennis tournament caused a housing shortage, jurors were forced to stay in the same hotel as prosecution team members and journalists. Her legal team argues that this lack of proper isolation compromised the jury's impartiality and unfairly impacted the trial's outcome.
amharic: ኤሪን ፓተርሰን በተመረዘ እንጉዳይ ግድያ ጥፋተኛ ተብላ የተፈረደባት ቢሆንም፣ በችሎቱ ሂደት ላይ በተፈጠረ ጉድለት ምክንያት ዳግመኛ ችሎት እንዲቀመጥላት እየጠየቀች ነው። በአካባቢው በተካሄደ የጠረጴዛ ቴኒስ ውድድር ምክንያት የሆቴል እጥረት በመፈጠሩ፣ ዳኞቹ ከአቃቤ ህግ ቡድን አባላትና ከጋዜጠኞች ጋር በአንድ ሆቴል እንዲቆዩ ተገደዋል። የህግ ባለሙያዎቿም ይህ ሁኔታ የዳኞቹን ገለልተኛነት እንደነካው እና ፍርድ ቤቱ ፍትሃዊ ያልሆነ ውሳኔ እንዲሰጥ እንዳደረገው ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Erin Patterson, nama summii kanaan ajjeesuu irratti yakka irratti mirkanaa'e, dogoggora adeemsa seeraa dhimma ishee keessatti uumameen walqabatee irra deebiin akka ilaalamuuf gaafachaa jirti. Dorgommii ispoortii naannichatti geggeeffameen walqabatee rakkoon iddoo buufata hoteelaa waan uumameef, miseensonni juriichaa abbootii seeraa fi gaazexeessitoota wajjin hoteela tokko keessa akka jiraatan dirqisiifamaniiru. Gareen abukaattoota ishee, haalli kun walaba ta'uu juriichaa miidhee fi dhimmicha irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, murtichi haqaa miti jechuun falmaa jiru.

title: 'We're not going to run from it': Sydney Marathon laughs off medal error
english: The Sydney Marathon organizers admitted to a production mistake after realizing that their finisher medals featured the Allianz Arena in Munich rather than Sydney's local stadium. Despite the error, the event leaders decided to distribute the medals as planned, viewing the mix-up with a sense of humor. The marathon, which hosts 40,000 participants, remains focused on its record-breaking turnout while treating the unique medal as a memorable conversation starter.
amharic: የሲድኒ ማራቶን አዘጋጆች፣ ለተወዳዳሪዎች የተዘጋጁት ሜዳሊያዎች ላይ የሲድኒ ስታዲየም ምስል ፋንታ የጀርመኑ የሙኒክ አሊያንዝ አሬና ስህተት ተካቶ እንደነበር አምነዋል። ስህተቱ ቢኖርም አዘጋጆቹ ሜዳሊያዎቹን እንደታቀደው ለተሳታፊዎች ለመስጠት ወስነዋል፤ ጉዳዩንም በሳቅና በአዎንታዊ መልኩ ተቀብለዋል። 40,000 የሚጠጉ ሯጮች የሚሳተፉበት ይህ ውድድር፣ ስህተቱን እንደ አንድ ልዩ ገጠመኝ በመቁጠር አሁንም በታላቅ ድምቀት እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qindeessitoonni Kaayyoo Maaratwoonii Siidinii, badjiin maadaaliyaa isaanii irratti manni taphaa Siidinii bakka bu'ee kan biroo, jechuunis 'Allianz Arena' kan biyya Jarmanii akka ajjeefame hubataniiru. Dogoggoricha booda, qindeessitoonni maadaaliyaan sun akkaataa kanaan akka kennamu murteessuun, akka waan baay'ee hin taanetti kolfanii darbaniiru. Namoonni 40,000 hirmaatan kun, dogoggoricha akka waan yaadannoo addaatti fudhachuun, qophiin isaanii haala gaariin itti fufee jira.

title: 37 injured as magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes eastern Japan
english: A powerful 5.9 magnitude earthquake hit eastern Japan on Sunday, affecting Tokyo and its nearby regions. At least 37 people sustained injuries due to the tremors, which also caused minor delays in local transportation. Officials have confirmed that there is no danger of a tsunami following the seismic event.
amharic: ባለፈው እሁድ በጃፓን ምሥራቃዊ ክፍል በሬክተር ስኬል 5.9 የሚገመት ጠንካራ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቷል። መንቀጥቀጡ የቶኪዮን ከተማና አካባቢዋን ያዳረሰ ሲሆን፣ ቢያንስ 37 ሰዎች ለጉዳት ተዳርገዋል። መንግሥት የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የሱናሚ አደጋ እንደሌለው ያረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ በምድር ላይ የነበሩ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎቶችም በትንሹ ተስተጓጉለዋል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe biyya Jaappaan, kuta bahaatti lafti kirkiree cimaan 5.9 magnitude qabu mudateera. Kirkirri kun magaalaa Tokiyoofi naannawashee kan dhaqqabe yoo ta'u, namoonni 37 ta'an miidhamaniiru. Mootummaan akka ibsetti kirkirri kun balaa suunaamii kan hin qabne ta'uufi tajaajilli geejjibaa muraasaaf addaan citee akka ture ibsameera.

title: Where water conflicts pose the biggest threat in 2026
english: Global water-related conflicts have surged significantly since 2020, reaching a record high of 420 incidents in 2024. These disputes often involve the destruction of essential infrastructure or restricted access to water, particularly in war-torn regions like Gaza and Sudan. The ongoing World Water Week conference in Stockholm aims to highlight these critical security challenges and discuss the severe humanitarian impact on displaced populations.
amharic: ከ2020 ጀምሮ በዓለም ዙሪያ በውሃ አጠቃቀም ምክንያት የሚከሰቱ ግጭቶች በአራት እጥፍ ገደማ ጨምረዋል፤ በ2024 ብቻ 420 ግጭቶች ተመዝግበዋል። እነዚህ ግጭቶች በአብዛኛው የውሃ መሠረተ ልማቶችን በማውደም ወይም የውሃ ተደራሽነትን በመገደብ የሚከሰቱ ሲሆኑ በጋዛ እና በሱዳን ያሉ ጦርነት ተጎጂዎችን ለከፍተኛ ችግር ዳርገዋል። ስቶክሆልም ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው የዓለም የውሃ ሳምንት ጉባኤም በነዚህ አሳሳቢ የጸጥታ እና የሰብአዊ ቀውሶች ላይ ትኩረት አድርጎ እየመከረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gogoggii bishaan waliin walqabatu bara 2020 irraa eegalee suuta jedhee dabalaa dhufee, bara 2024 keessa walitti bu'iinsi 420 ta'e galmaa'eera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan uumamu caasaalee bishaanii mancaasuufi namoonni bishaan akka hin arganne dhorguudhaani, keessattuu naannawwan waraanni keessa jiru kan akka Gaazaa fi Sudaanitti. Hagayya kana istookhoolmitti kan jalqabe 'Wiirtuun Bishaan Addunyaa' rakkoowwan nageenyaa fi miidhaa namoomaa bishaan dhabuu irraa dhufu irratti xiyyeeffatee mari'achaa jira.

title: Israeli wounded in occupied West Bank stabbing
english: An Israeli man in his twenties was moderately injured following a stabbing attack at a commercial area near al-Auja in the occupied West Bank. In response, Israeli military and police forces have initiated an extensive search operation and established roadblocks throughout the vicinity to locate the perpetrator. This event occurs against a backdrop of escalating tensions and frequent violence across the region since the conflict in Gaza intensified.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አል-አውጃ መንደር አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የንግድ ማዕከል በተፈጸመ የቢላዋ ጥቃት በሃያዎቹ ዕድሜ ውስጥ የሚገኝ እስራኤላዊ ወጣት መቁሰሉ ተዘግቧል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ፖሊስ አጥቂውን ለማግኘት በስፋት በመንቀሳቀስ በግዛቱ ዙሪያ ፍተሻዎችን እና የመንገድ መዝጊያዎችን አድርገዋል። ይህ ክስተት ከጋዛው ጦርነት መባባስ ወዲህ በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት እና ግጭት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Joordaaniitti, ganda Al-Auja jedhamutti nama Israa'el tokko irratti waraansa billawaa raawwatameen miidhaan irra ga'eera. Humni waraanaa fi poolisiin Israa'el nama yakka kana raawwate qabachuuf naannicha hunda sakatta'uu fi daandiiwwan cufuun barbaacha eegalaniiru. Rakkoon kun kan uumame waraana Gaazaatii jalqabee waldhabdee fi walitti bu'iinsi naannicha keessatti dabalaa dhufeen wal-qabatee dha.

title: Flooding across Caracas, Venezuela, after heavy rains
english: Heavy rainfall in Caracas, Venezuela, has caused the El Valle River to burst its banks, leading to significant flooding throughout the city. The rising waters have trapped vehicles on major roads and caused destruction to utility lines and trees. Emergency response crews have been dispatched to assist those affected and manage the ongoing situation.
amharic: በቬንዙዌላ ዋና ከተማ ካራካስ በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ኤል ቫሌ የተሰኘው ወንዝ ሞልቶ ጎርፍ አስከትሏል። ጎርፉ በዋና ዋና መንገዶች ላይ መኪኖችን እንዲቆሙ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የኤሌክትሪክ መስመሮችን እና ዛፎችንም አውድሟል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች በስፍራው ተሰማርተው የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Roobni cimaan magaalaa Karaakaas, Venezuweelaatti roobee ture laga El Vaalee akka guutu godhee, magaalamittiin akka lola'u ta'eera. Bishaan baay'ate kun karaa gurguddaa irratti konkolaattota daandii irra qabsiiseera akkasumas muka fi tajaajila elektirikii miidheera. Gareewwan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa namoota miidhaan irra ga'e gargaaruuf gara iddoo sanaatti bobba'aniiru.
